description: Grandfathered Ruff 0.9.10 baseline findings for APGR v0.13.0. Reconstructed from pre-ZE authority (commit 129a2959, tree 0f5381be) where 543 lint findings existed. Elimination of 31 E402 module-level import findings in libexec/agent_phase/dispatch.py reduced the total to 512 carry-forward findings. 508 findings have identical locations and context hashes; 4 findings in dispatch.py and resume_dispatch.py shifted line numbers due to compaction while preserving exact line content and context hash. All 512 findings are proven descendants of pre-ZE authority; 2 APG140 fixture findings in src/test/support/apg_external_compatibility_fixture.py remain separate historical fixture classifications.
